rules: Prompt rules: (1) Write one concrete, objective English paragraph (60-150 words): subject and count, composition/viewpoint, style/medium (e.g. flat vector illustration, isometric 3D render, photo), color palette (name the deck's colors), lighting, background. (2) Negative prompts do not work; put exclusions in the prompt itself, e.g. 'no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark'. (3) Text renders reliably only in English or Chinese and only when the exact words are in double quotes with position and size (e.g. a sign reading "LiteLLM" at the top center). Never request Japanese text in an image; put it on the slide instead. (4) Screens, dashboards, signs and documents get garbled pseudo-text unless you say they show only abstract shapes and bars. (5) No metaphors, no emotional words, no meta tags such as 8K or masterpiece. (6) For slides: use a plain background in the deck's background color and leave empty space where slide text will go. (7) The generated background never matches the slide background exactly. Show each image as a deliberate panel (a framed card, or a large area of the slide); do not try to hide its edge by cropping, recoloring or regenerating. Regenerate an image at most once, and only for a wrong subject or garbled text. (8) Do not use imagegen for small icons or badges (anything under about 200 pt). Draw those with shapes instead: an oval or rounded square in an accent color with a number or one short word in it. Use imagegen for 1-3 large visuals per deck (hero image, illustration, scene). (9) imagegen is for illustrations and photos (objects, scenes, atmosphere). Do not use it for diagrams, flowcharts, comparisons, timelines, charts or other infographics: they come out as decorative pseudo-diagrams that explain nothing. Draw those with shapes, arrows and tables in pptcom.

size.description: Pixel size. 1024x1024 square (icons, side images); 1024x768 or 1024x512 wide (hero, banner, background strip); 768x1024 or 512x1024 tall. Default 1024x1024.
